_rule: Read scripts/check-stock-writer-lock.mjs. Every file that writes StockLevel is listed with its exact number of write sites. lock=true files must call lockProductStock( first in each writing transaction. Database functions that write StockLevel are listed under sqlFunctions and must take the product lock (FOR NO KEY UPDATE on "Product") before their first write.

apps/api/src/services/stock-movement.ser.why: applyStockMovementInTx: the level update or create, after lockProductStock(tx, [productId]).

apps/api/src/services/stock-level.servic.why: reserveStockInTx, releaseReservation and consumeReservation: each locks the product before reading the level.

apps/api/src/services/stock-import.servi.why: Bulk import chunk: applyProducts locks the chunk's products, then plans and writes in the same transaction.

apps/api/src/routes/stock.routes.ts.why: Threshold-only writes (reorderThreshold / reorderQuantity). They never set quantity, reserved or available, so they cannot lose a stock update.

nexus_pool_reserve.why: Shared stock door 2 (hold): locks the lender product, then raises reserved on one lent level.

nexus_pool_release.why: Shared stock door 3 (give back): locks each held product, then lowers reserved.

nexus_pool_consume.why: Shared stock door 4a (take out a hold): locks each held product, then lowers quantity and reserved.

nexus_pool_take.why: Shared stock door 4b (take out at once): locks the lender product, then lowers quantity on the lent levels.

nexus_pool_put_back.why: Shared stock door 5 (put back): locks the lender product, then raises quantity on the level, or creates it.

nexus_pool_lender_release.why: The lender's stock-page release of a pool hold its borrower's cancellation kept (the borrower's order is cancelled or refunded): locks the lender product, then lowers reserved on the one level.

apps/api/src/services/stock-level.servic.why: The one owner of order holds (stock model R2): reserveStockInTx creates, releaseReservationInTx and consumeReservationInTx settle, and takeFromHoldInTx splits a hold at what shipped (a partial fulfilment: the shipped part is consumed, a continuing hold keeps the rest). Every channel writer, the reconcile, E3 and the stock page go through these.

nexus_pool_reserve.why: Shared stock door 2 (hold) creates the lender's reservation for the borrower's order.

nexus_pool_release.why: Shared stock door 3 (give back) marks the order's open pool holds released.

nexus_pool_consume.why: Shared stock door 4a (take out) marks the order's open pool holds consumed.

nexus_pool_lender_release.why: Marks that one kept pool hold released, lender only, after the borrower's order is cancelled or refunded.

apps/api/src/services/stock/stock-cases..why: The one owner of case counts, case sizes and case packs (Step 3 cases; several case sizes per SKU, 2026-10-08): keepCasesInTx clamps or moves a level's sealed cases per size (update, create; the caller — applyStockMovementInTx, the import chunk, the pool settle — holds the product lock), setCasesInTx sets absolute counts per size (upsert, after lockProductStock), setCasePacks replaces a SKU's case sizes and owners (productCaseSize deleteMany, update, createMany — a removed size's counts go with it by cascade — and productPackage deleteMany / upsert, after lockProductStock), setFbaOwnersIfUnset (Step 4 Send to FBA) writes only the null prep/label owner columns (a createMany and two updateMany, after lockProductStock).

apps/api/src/services/stock-level.servic.why: The one owner of an order's stock movements (stock model R2): consumeReservation (RESERVATION_CONSUMED), takeOrderUnitsWithLots and takeOrderUnitsInTx (ORDER_PLACED, taken at ingest), giveBackOrderTakes (ORDER_CANCELLED, E3).
